title: Google Solitaire Speedrun in 0:30 30 Seconds Easy Mode
description:
#speedrun New world record for Google Solitaire easy for speedrun.com when set.

This run uses mouse keys: hold alt+shift+num lock to toggle mouse keys, you can get the num pad to perform mouse functions.

The future of Google Solitaire speedruns still rests in the hands of the speedrun.com moderators for the game. They are part of the Google Doodle speedrun community, join the discord and say hello! https://discord.gg/7MXyJHs

Music is 10,000 Maniacs How You've Grown https://youtu.be/aYPpoKaXWAw

transcript: [Music] my heart you've grown [Music] i remember just wait and see [Music] it's time for another solitaire time and there comes a time for all speed runners big and small no matter how many world records they've obtained that they lose sight of the big picture just to get that fastest video yesterday i uploaded a speed run of google solitaire on easy mode at 25 seconds that use the right mouse button on the mouse to repeatedly double click just by holding it down otherwise known as turbo this is a widely frowned upon and banned practice throughout console based speed runs and that's why i want to point out that i never intended that run to be verified on speedrun.com or adjudicated by a moderator it was more meant as a proof of concept just in case somewhere down the line that rule becomes allowed for this game specifically since it's such an easy thing to do for everyone with a mouse that if it ever becomes allowed i could use that video my greatest mistake i put the words world record in the title of the video and for any innocent bystanders who interpreted that as me claiming the top spot in the speedrun.com leaderboard i apologize but that was not my intention the story doesn't end there though our friend the last person to have the record my name is andy taking a closer look at his youtube video description i see that it says no one said we couldn't use mouse keys i did a little investigation and i found that mouse keys is where you use your numpad to do stuff that your mouse would do and in this case you can set it so that the plus button on your numpad double clicks so with that not only will i bring you the world record google solitaire speed run of the day but it will also have external audio for the fans and hand cam with mouse and that fabled numpad button for the fans please enjoy the new google solitaire world record [Music] a bunch of sweaty teenage boys thanks [Music] [Music] [Music] is
